description: Social plan Task 2b (lane S; migration 0023_moderation_reports): three new, empty, platform-wide tables: content_reports (a report names its target by type and id; the reporter's words are kept only sealed), moderation_actions (what a moderator did) and moderation_evidence (a sealed copy of the content for a child-safety report). The app's role can add and read moderation_actions and moderation_evidence and cannot update or delete them. Nothing existing is altered. Additive: no row, account, email, phone, session, role or membership may change. Live traffic keeps writing while the migration runs, so the tables below are listed as volatile.
